verdict: Purchases are up sharply; overdue funnel infrastructure needs to close now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads delivered a 4.18x return on ad spend, and purchases jumped 37.5% in the most recent 7-day window compared to the prior 7 days — on slightly lower daily spend of $48.63, meaning the efficiency gains are real. The final three days of the period (Oct 11–13) logged 8 purchases versus just 1 in the three days before that, confirming the momentum is continuing into this week. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile generated 496 actions — 24 calls, 94 direction requests, and 378 website clicks — though profile activity dropped sharply in the last two days of the window, which we are monitoring closely. Several funnel and attribution milestones — including UTM tracking, email flows, and subscribe page rebuilds — are overdue and are being resolved as the immediate priority, as completing them will protect and extend the ad performance gains you are seeing now.
